zh.name: 帽
zh.rule: 棗紅色軟帽，連童軍（金屬）帽章：帽章戴喺軟帽黑色膠邊左眼上方約 2 釐米。軟帽戴喺眉毛上約 2 釐米，向右邊拉低。宣誓後纔可佩戴。

en.name: Beret
en.rule: Maroon beret with the (metal) Scout cap badge, worn on the black band about 2 cm above the left eye. The beret sits about 2 cm above the eyebrows, pulled down to the right. Worn only after investiture.

modelNote.zh: 帽章圖案取自手冊 P.102 相片；方塊人嘅軟帽只係示意形狀。
modelNote.en: Cap badge artwork from the Handbook p.102 photo; the blocky beret is only an indicative shape.

zh.name: 恤衫
zh.rule: 杏色、短袖、兩胸袋、無褶、肩帶。

en.name: Shirt
en.rule: Beige, short sleeves, two chest pockets, no pleats, shoulder straps.

zh.name: 長褲／半截裙
zh.rule: 男團員：草青色長褲，兩斜袋、兩後袋、有褶。女團員：草青色半截裙，側袋、無褶、及膝；或者女性深資童軍長褲制服（手冊 P.50–51）：草青色長褲，兩斜袋、兩後袋、有褶。

en.name: Trousers / skirt
en.rule: Boys: grass-green trousers, two slanted pockets, two back pockets, pleated. Girls: grass-green skirt, side pockets, no pleats, knee length; or the female Venture Scout trouser uniform (Handbook pp.50–51): grass-green trousers, two slanted pockets, two back pockets, pleated.

modelNote.zh: 模型預設半截裙（一件過，中間冇線），女團員可以喺服裝分頁改長褲。
modelNote.en: The model defaults to the skirt (one piece, no centre line); girls can switch to trousers in the Outfit tab.

en.name: Belt
en.rule: Brown, with the Scout badge buckle.

modelNote.zh: 皮帶扣只畫銀色方塊示意。
modelNote.en: The buckle is a plain silver block.

zh.name: 襪
zh.rule: 男團員：黑色短襪。女團員：肉色、尼龍、無花、襪褲（配半截裙）；長褲制服配黑色襪（手冊 P.50）。

en.name: Socks
en.rule: Boys: black short socks. Girls: flesh-coloured plain nylon tights (with the skirt); black socks with the trouser uniform (Handbook p.50).

zh.name: 皮鞋
zh.rule: 男團員：黑色、無花紋、綁帶。女團員：黑色、無花紋、非綁帶、中跟（配半截裙）；長褲制服配黑色、無花紋、綁帶皮鞋（手冊 P.50）。

en.name: Shoes
en.rule: Boys: black, plain, laced. Girls: black, plain, not laced, medium heel (with the skirt); black plain laced shoes with the trouser uniform (Handbook p.50).

modelNote.zh: 半截裙配非綁帶中跟皮鞋：用方塊砌，後面一舊中跟、前面鞋掌貼地，中間腳弓位係空；鞋面開口大，見到肉色襪褲，黑色只係鞋邊同鞋頭（用戶指正）。長褲配綁帶皮鞋。
modelNote.en: With the skirt: non-laced medium-heel shoes built from blocks — a heel block at the back, the sole on the ground at the front and a hollow under the arch; a wide opening shows the flesh-coloured tights, with black only round the edge and toe (user correction). With trousers: laced shoes.

zh.name: 領巾
zh.rule: 旅巾（連童軍巾圈）；或者改戴領帶（領帶制服，手冊 P.48）。宣誓後纔可佩戴。著毛衣時領巾放喺毛衣外面（手冊 P.122）。

en.name: Neckerchief
en.rule: Group neckerchief with the Scout woggle; or a tie instead (tie uniform, Handbook p.48). Worn only after investiture. With the jersey the neckerchief goes outside it (Handbook p.122).

modelNote.zh: 旅巾顏色由各旅自定，模型可自選；巾圈畫做啡色皮巾圈（手冊 P.110）。
modelNote.en: Neckerchief colours are set by each Group; pick them in the model. The woggle is drawn as the brown leather Scout woggle (Handbook p.110).

zh.name: 領帶（可選，代替旅巾）
zh.rule: 深資童軍領帶制服（手冊 P.48）：深資童軍戴棗紅色領帶（手冊 P.113「深資海童軍及深資空童軍除外」）。其餘衣物同徽章同旅巾制服一樣。著毛衣時領帶放喺毛衣同恤衫之間（手冊 P.122）。

en.name: Tie (optional, instead of the neckerchief)
en.rule: Venture Scout tie uniform (Handbook p.48): Venture Scouts wear the maroon tie (Handbook p.113, “except Venture Sea and Venture Air Scouts”). Everything else, including badges, is as the neckerchief uniform. With the jersey the tie goes between the jersey and the shirt (Handbook p.122).

modelNote.zh: 同旅巾一樣，宣誓後先戴（用戶確認）。
modelNote.en: Like the neckerchief, worn only after investiture (user confirmed).

zh.name: 制服毛衣（可選）
zh.rule: 可因應個人體質或天氣情況穿著深草青色制服毛衣。領巾放喺毛衣外面；毛衣上只可以喺適當位置戴世界童軍會員章、香港章同旅章，同埋喺毛衣雙肩肩帶上戴深資童軍肩章，其他章唔可以戴喺毛衣上。

en.name: Uniform jersey (optional)
en.rule: A dark grass-green uniform jersey may be worn for personal comfort or the weather. The neckerchief goes outside the jersey; only the World Membership Badge, Hong Kong Badge and Group Badge, and the Venture Scout Epaulettes on the jersey’s shoulder straps may be worn on it, in the appropriate places; no other badges.

modelNote.zh: 毛衣畫做長袖、坑紋、圓領（見到恤衫領）、膊頭淺色膊布（手冊 P.121–122 附圖）。徽章「或制服毛衣相同位置」：位置同恤衫一樣，向外移一個毛衣厚度。
modelNote.en: The jersey is drawn long-sleeved and ribbed, with a crew neck (shirt collar showing) and lighter shoulder patches (Handbook pp.121–122 figures). Badges go in “the same position on the uniform jersey”: the shirt positions, moved out by the jersey thickness.

en.name: Venture Scouts
en.note: Venture Scouts (Handbook pp.36–37; Training Scheme pp.14–15).

zh.name: 深資海童軍
zh.note: 深資海童軍（手冊 P.38–39；綱要 P.14–15）：徽章同擺位同深資童軍一樣（手冊 P.170「包括深資海童軍及深資空童軍」）；帽、恤衫、長褲／半截裙唔同。

en.name: Venture Sea Scouts
en.note: Venture Sea Scouts (Handbook pp.38–39; Training Scheme pp.14–15): the same badges in the same places as Venture Scouts (Handbook p.170 “including Venture Sea Scouts and Venture Air Scouts”); the cap, shirt and trousers/skirt differ.

zh.name: 帽
zh.rule: 男團員：海童軍男領袖白頂帽；女團員：海童軍女領袖白頂帽；都連深資海童軍帽章。戴時帽邊喺眼眉上方約 2 釐米，整頂帽邊同水平線看齊（手冊 P.101）。宣誓後纔可佩戴。

en.name: Cap
en.rule: Boys: Sea Scout male leader's white-top cap; girls: Sea Scout female leader's white-top cap; both with the Venture Sea Scout cap badge. The brim sits about 2 cm above the eyebrows and the whole brim is level (Handbook p.101). Worn only after investiture.

modelNote.zh: 帽章圖案取自手冊 P.102 相片（細圖放大），按 P.101 附圖放喺帽前黑色帽帶中央。方塊人嘅白頂帽只係示意形狀：男裝白頂較闊、黑色帽舌；女裝白頂細啲、後面向上翹、帽舌短啲。
modelNote.en: Cap badge artwork from the Handbook p.102 photo (a small image enlarged), placed at the front centre of the black band as in the p.101 figure. The blocky caps are only indicative: the men's cap has a wider white top and a black peak; the women's has a smaller top tilted up at the back and a shorter peak.

modelNote.en: Like the neckerchief, worn only after investiture (user confirmed).

zh.name: 制服毛衣（可選）
zh.rule: 可因應個人體質或天氣情況穿著深藍色制服毛衣。領巾放喺毛衣外面；毛衣上只可以喺適當位置戴世界童軍會員章、香港章同旅章，同埋喺毛衣雙肩肩帶上戴深資童軍肩章，其他章唔可以戴喺毛衣上。

en.name: Uniform jersey (optional)
en.rule: A dark blue uniform jersey may be worn for personal comfort or the weather. The neckerchief goes outside the jersey; only the World Membership Badge, Hong Kong Badge and Group Badge, and the Venture Scout Epaulettes on the jersey’s shoulder straps may be worn on it, in the appropriate places; no other badges.

modelNote.zh: 手冊 P.121：海童軍／空童軍青少年成員穿深藍色制服毛衣；深資海童軍、深資空童軍都係（用戶確認）。毛衣畫做長袖、坑紋、圓領（見到恤衫領）、膊頭淺色膊布（手冊 P.121–122 附圖）。徽章「或制服毛衣相同位置」：位置同恤衫一樣，向外移一個毛衣厚度。
modelNote.en: Handbook p.121: Sea/Air Scout youth members wear the dark blue jersey; Venture Sea and Venture Air Scouts are included (user confirmed). The jersey is drawn long-sleeved and ribbed, with a crew neck (shirt collar showing) and lighter shoulder patches (Handbook pp.121–122 figures). Badges go in “the same position on the uniform jersey”: the shirt positions, moved out by the jersey thickness.

zh.name: 世界童軍會員章
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋中央。
zh.quote: 童軍成員佩戴在制服恤衫……左胸袋中央位置，或制服毛衣相同位置。童軍成員宣誓後纔可佩戴。
zh.conditions: 宣誓後纔可佩戴。

en.name: World Membership Badge
en.place: Centre of the wearer's left chest pocket.
en.quote: Worn centred on the left chest pocket of the uniform shirt, or the same position on the uniform sweater. Worn only after investiture.
en.conditions: Worn only after investiture.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用直徑 4 cm，按 P.170 附圖同胸袋嘅比例。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 4 cm diameter, from its proportion to the pocket in the p.170 figure.

zh.name: 香港章
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋袋蓋上方 3 釐米，置中。
zh.quote: 幼童軍、童軍及深資童軍佩戴在制服恤衫左胸袋袋蓋上方三釐米中央位置，或制服毛衣相同位置。
zh.conditions: 基本徽章。

en.name: Hong Kong Badge
en.place: Centred 3 cm above the flap of the wearer's left chest pocket.
en.quote: Cub Scouts, Scouts and Venture Scouts wear it centred 3 cm above the left chest pocket flap of the uniform shirt, or the same position on the sweater.
en.conditions: Basic badge.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 4 × 5.6 cm（跟 P.93 圖案比例）。 同飛行章／跳傘章一齊戴時，飛行章喺袋蓋上方 2 cm、香港章喺佢上面（手冊 P.93、P.170 附圖）。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 4 × 5.6 cm (the p.93 artwork's proportions). With the Flying/Parachute Badge, the wings go 2 cm above the flap and the Hong Kong Badge above them (Handbook p.93 and the p.170 figure).

zh.name: 旅章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，肩膊縫線下方 2 釐米，置中。
zh.quote: 旅成員佩戴在制服恤衫……右袖肩膊位下方二釐米中央位置，或制服毛衣相同位置。
zh.conditions: 基本徽章；由所屬旅提供。

en.name: Group Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, centred 2 cm below the shoulder seam.
en.quote: Group members wear it centred 2 cm below the shoulder on the right sleeve of the uniform shirt, or the same position on the sweater.
en.conditions: Basic badge; supplied by the Group.

modelNote.zh: 手冊 P.94：新成立旅嘅旅章不小過 8.5 × 2 cm、不大過 10.5 × 2.5 cm；模型用 9 × 2.2 cm。圖案係手冊示例（2222 旅），各旅實際圖案唔同。
modelNote.en: Handbook p.94: a new Group's badge is between 8.5 × 2 cm and 10.5 × 2.5 cm; the model uses 9 × 2.2 cm. The artwork is the handbook example (2222th Group); each Group's badge differs.

zh.name: 地域章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，旅章下方 2 釐米；地域章在前（靠穿著者前面），區章在後，兩章相距 1 釐米。
zh.quote: 區幹部……及旅成員同時佩戴所屬地域章及區章在制服恤衫右袖香港肩章／旅章下方二釐米中央位置；地域章在前，區章在後，兩章相距一釐米。
zh.conditions: 基本徽章；跟所屬區嘅地域。

en.name: Region Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, 2 cm below the Group Badge; Region Badge in front (toward the wearer's front), District Badge behind, 1 cm apart.
en.quote: Group members wear both the Region and District Badges centred 2 cm below the Group Badge on the right sleeve; Region Badge in front, District Badge behind, 1 cm apart.
en.conditions: Basic badge; the Region of the member's District.

modelNote.zh: 圖案跟「區章」揀咗嘅區自動轉做所屬地域；未揀區就用手冊 P.168 示例色塊。總會總部屬下嘅區（例如銀禧區）網頁冇列地域章，模型唔顯示。手冊 P.170 附圖：開咗深資童軍急救章，佢就喺旅章同地域／區章中間（P.148），地域章、區章跟住向下移；冇急救章就照 P.95：喺旅章下 2 cm。只得一個（例如總會總部屬下嘅銀禧區冇地域章，或者熄咗其中一個）就放喺旅章下面中間（用戶指示）。
modelNote.en: The artwork follows the Region of the District picked under District Badge; with no District picked it uses the Handbook p.168 example block. Districts under AHQ (e.g. Silver Jubilee) have no Region Badge on the web page, so none is shown. Handbook p.170 figure: with the Venture Scout First Aid Badge on, it sits between the Group Badge and the Region/District Badges (p.148) and these move down; without it, per p.95, they sit 2 cm below the Group Badge. When only one of the pair is worn (e.g. Silver Jubilee District under AHQ has no Region Badge, or one is switched off) it goes centred below the Group Badge (user instruction).

zh.name: 區章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，旅章下方 2 釐米；喺地域章後面，相距 1 釐米。
zh.quote: 地域章在前，區章在後，兩章相距一釐米。地域章及區章……尺寸是 3.8 釐米（闊）× 5 釐米（高）。
zh.conditions: 基本徽章；揀返自己所屬嘅區。

en.name: District Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, 2 cm below the Group Badge; behind the Region Badge, 1 cm apart.
en.quote: Region Badge in front, District Badge behind, 1 cm apart. Region and District Badges are 3.8 cm wide × 5 cm high.
en.conditions: Basic badge; pick your own District.

modelNote.zh: 可以揀全港所有區（香港童軍總會網頁「地域及區」）；未揀區就用手冊示例色塊。只得一個（例如總會總部屬下嘅銀禧區冇地域章，或者熄咗其中一個）就放喺旅章下面中間（用戶指示）。
modelNote.en: Every District can be picked (SAHK “Regions and Districts” page); with none picked it uses the handbook example block. When only one of the pair is worn (e.g. Silver Jubilee District under AHQ has no Region Badge, or one is switched off) it goes centred below the Group Badge (user instruction).

zh.name: 深資童軍肩章
zh.place: 雙肩肩帶上（制服恤衫或制服毛衣）。
zh.quote: 符合相關資格的深資童軍／樂行童軍可佩戴相關的深資童軍肩章／樂行童軍肩章在制服恤衫或制服毛衣雙肩肩帶上。
zh.conditions: 為「剛獲頒會員章」（已宣誓）嘅深資童軍而設；完成肩章訓練（正常加入後六個月內）、由深資童軍團長簽發後纔可佩戴（綱要 P.19）。可以喺徽章分頁揀「未考獲」或「已考獲」。

en.name: Venture Scout Epaulettes
en.place: On both shoulder straps (uniform shirt or uniform jersey).
en.quote: Qualified Venture Scouts / Rover Scouts may wear the Venture Scout / Rover Scout Epaulettes on both shoulder straps of the uniform shirt or uniform jersey.
en.conditions: For Venture Scouts who have just received the Membership Badge (invested); worn after completing the epaulette training (normally within six months of joining) and being signed off by the Venture Scout Leader (Training Scheme p.19). Choose “not yet earned” or “earned” in the Badges tab.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 9 × 3.8 cm（手冊 P.145 圖案比例），套喺肩帶上：肩帶由衣領一直去到膊頭（袖頂外邊，用戶指正）；肩章方角、有徽號嗰頭近膊頭，圓頭近衣領（P.145、P.170 附圖）。圖案取自手冊 P.145（細圖放大）。三款制服都係棗紅色肩章（P.170「包括深資海童軍及深資空童軍」）。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 9 × 3.8 cm (proportions of the Handbook p.145 artwork), the strap runs from the collar all the way to the shoulder point (outer edge of the sleeve top, user correction); slid onto the strap with the square, emblem end at the shoulder and the rounded end at the collar (pp.145, 170 figures). Artwork from Handbook p.145 (a small image enlarged). All three uniforms use the maroon epaulettes (p.170 “including Venture Sea Scouts and Venture Air Scouts”).

zh.name: 優異旅團章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，袖口縫線上方中央，為期一年。
zh.quote: 佩戴在制服恤衫右袖縫線上方中央位置，為期一年。有紅、紫和粉藍等三種顏色，每年輪流使用。
zh.conditions: 「優異旅團獎勵計劃」獲獎旅團嘅領袖、教練員及團員；為期一年。

en.name: Meritorious Group Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, centred above the sleeve-hem seam, for one year.
en.quote: Worn centred above the right sleeve seam of the uniform shirt, for one year. Comes in red, purple and light blue, used in turn each year.
en.conditions: Leaders, instructors and members of a Group awarded under the Meritorious Group Scheme; for one year.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 9 × 2 cm（P.159 圖案比例）。可以輸入年份：圖案底色同文字取自 P.159，只換年份數字；顏色每 3 年輪一次（1999 紅、2000 紫、2001 藍……，P.159 2016 藍、2017 紅、2018 紫吻合）。 手冊 P.170 附圖：深資童軍嘅優異旅團章喺右袖最下、貼近袖口縫線。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 9 × 2 cm (p.159 artwork proportions). Type a year: the background and lettering come from p.159 and only the year digits change; the colour cycles every 3 years (1999 red, 2000 purple, 2001 blue…, matching 2016 blue, 2017 red, 2018 purple on p.159). Handbook p.170 figure: for Venture Scouts the Meritorious Group Badge is lowest on the right sleeve, just above the cuff seam.

zh.name: 深資童軍獎章／榮譽童軍獎章
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋中央（手冊 P.170 附圖「深資童軍進度性獎章」）。
zh.quote: 深資童軍完成「深資童軍肩章」後，才可開始考取本獎章（深資童軍獎章）。深資童軍完成任何一個「深資童軍獎章」段章後，即可開始考取本獎章（榮譽童軍獎章）。
zh.conditions: 深資童軍進度性訓練：完成四個段章 → 深資童軍獎章；完成四條金帶 → 榮譽童軍獎章。只戴最高嗰個。

en.name: Venture Scout Award / Dragon Scout Award
en.place: Centre of the wearer's right chest pocket (Handbook p.170 figure, “Venture Scout progress award”).
en.quote: Venture Scouts may only begin the Venture Scout Award after completing the Venture Scout Epaulettes. Upon completing any one of the Badges under the Venture Scout Award, a Venture Scout may begin working towards the Dragon Scout Award.
en.conditions: Venture Scout progressive training: all four Badges → Venture Scout Award; all four Bars → Dragon Scout Award. Wear only the higher one.

modelNote.zh: 圖案取自 2026 年 8 月版綱要 P.21–22（棗紅色「V」、綠色）；綱要冇寫位置，跟手冊 P.170 附圖戴喺右胸袋中央。手冊冇寫尺寸，模型用 4.5 cm 框。
modelNote.en: Artwork from the August 2026 Training Scheme pp.21–22 (maroon “V”, green); the Training Scheme gives no position, so it follows the Handbook p.170 figure at the centre of the right pocket. No size given; the model uses a 4.5 cm box.

zh.name: 活動策劃段章
zh.place: 穿著者左袖下方上行近前面（手冊 P.170 附圖「深資童軍段章及金帶」）；金帶喺佢下面。段章冇固定次序，邊個考先就戴先（由上至下、由前至後）；模型示範用綱要建議次序（「活動策劃」首個完成）。
zh.quote: 深資童軍在完成「活動策劃」、「社會服務」、「多元技能」及「戶外探險」任何一個段章內之全部項目，便可於制服佩戴該項目之段章。唯建議以「活動策劃」段章為首個完成之段章。
zh.conditions: 完成「活動策劃」段章全部項目（深資童軍獎章）。

en.name: Project Badge
en.place: Lower wearer's left sleeve, upper row, towards the front (Handbook p.170 figure, “Venture Scout badges and bars”); its Bar goes beneath it. The badges have no fixed order — the first earned goes first (top to bottom, front to back); the model follows the Training Scheme order (Project recommended first).
en.quote: Upon completing any one of the Badges (“Project”, “Service”, “Activity”, and “Exploration”), a Venture Scout may wear the corresponding badge on their uniform. It is highly recommended to complete the “Project” Badge first.
en.conditions: Complete all items of the Project Badge (Venture Scout Award).

modelNote.zh: 新段章圖案取自 2026 年 8 月版綱要 P.24；綱要冇寫位置同尺寸，跟手冊 P.170 附圖：左袖下面兩行、每行兩個（前、後），每個段章下面一條金帶，最底嗰行金帶貼住袖口縫線，中間係香港青年獎勵計劃獎章同拯溺布章。附圖冇寫邊個段章喺邊格，模型按綱要次序（活動策劃、社會服務、多元技能、戶外探險）由上至下、由前至後排。模型用 3.8 × 4 cm。
modelNote.en: New badge artwork from the August 2026 Training Scheme p.24; it gives no position or size, so the Handbook p.170 figure is followed: two rows of two (front, back) low on the left sleeve, each Badge with its Bar beneath, the bottom Bars on the hem seam, with the HKAYP and Life Saving Badges between the columns. The figure does not say which Badge goes where; the model uses the Training Scheme order (Project, Service, Activity, Exploration) top to bottom, front to back. The model uses 3.8 × 4 cm.

zh.name: 活動策劃金帶
zh.place: 穿著者左袖下方上行近前面，活動策劃段章下面（手冊 P.170 附圖）。
zh.quote: 深資童軍在完成「榮譽童軍獎章」內「活動策劃」、「社會服務」、「多元技能」及「戶外探險」任何一個項目後，便可在該項目之段章下佩戴一條金帶。
zh.conditions: 完成榮譽童軍獎章「活動策劃」項目；要先有活動策劃段章。

en.name: Project Bar
en.place: Lower wearer's left sleeve, upper row, towards the front, beneath the Project Badge (Handbook p.170 figure).
en.quote: Upon completing all requirements in any section of the Dragon Scout Award (“Project Bar”, “Service Bar”, “Activity Bar”, and “Exploration Bar”), the Venture Scout can wear the Bar under the corresponding Badges on the uniform.
en.conditions: Complete the Project section of the Dragon Scout Award; needs the Project Badge.

modelNote.zh: 金帶圖案取自綱要 P.16（棗紅底金色橫帶）；只會喺開咗對應段章時顯示。模型用 3.2 × 1.6 cm。
modelNote.en: Bar artwork from the Training Scheme p.16 (gold stripe on maroon); shown only when the matching Badge is on. The model uses 3.2 × 1.6 cm.

zh.name: 社會服務段章
zh.place: 穿著者左袖下方上行近後面（手冊 P.170 附圖「深資童軍段章及金帶」）；金帶喺佢下面。段章冇固定次序，邊個考先就戴先（由上至下、由前至後）；模型示範用綱要建議次序（「活動策劃」首個完成）。
zh.quote: 深資童軍在完成「活動策劃」、「社會服務」、「多元技能」及「戶外探險」任何一個段章內之全部項目，便可於制服佩戴該項目之段章。唯建議以「活動策劃」段章為首個完成之段章。
zh.conditions: 完成「社會服務」段章全部項目（深資童軍獎章）。

en.name: Service Badge
en.place: Lower wearer's left sleeve, upper row, towards the back (Handbook p.170 figure, “Venture Scout badges and bars”); its Bar goes beneath it. The badges have no fixed order — the first earned goes first (top to bottom, front to back); the model follows the Training Scheme order (Project recommended first).
en.quote: Upon completing any one of the Badges (“Project”, “Service”, “Activity”, and “Exploration”), a Venture Scout may wear the corresponding badge on their uniform. It is highly recommended to complete the “Project” Badge first.
en.conditions: Complete all items of the Service Badge (Venture Scout Award).

zh.name: 社會服務金帶
zh.place: 穿著者左袖下方上行近後面，社會服務段章下面（手冊 P.170 附圖）。
zh.quote: 深資童軍在完成「榮譽童軍獎章」內「活動策劃」、「社會服務」、「多元技能」及「戶外探險」任何一個項目後，便可在該項目之段章下佩戴一條金帶。
zh.conditions: 完成榮譽童軍獎章「社會服務」項目；要先有社會服務段章。

en.name: Service Bar
en.place: Lower wearer's left sleeve, upper row, towards the back, beneath the Service Badge (Handbook p.170 figure).
en.quote: Upon completing all requirements in any section of the Dragon Scout Award (“Project Bar”, “Service Bar”, “Activity Bar”, and “Exploration Bar”), the Venture Scout can wear the Bar under the corresponding Badges on the uniform.
en.conditions: Complete the Service section of the Dragon Scout Award; needs the Service Badge.

zh.name: 多元技能段章
zh.place: 穿著者左袖下方下行近前面（手冊 P.170 附圖「深資童軍段章及金帶」）；金帶喺佢下面。段章冇固定次序，邊個考先就戴先（由上至下、由前至後）；模型示範用綱要建議次序（「活動策劃」首個完成）。
zh.quote: 深資童軍在完成「活動策劃」、「社會服務」、「多元技能」及「戶外探險」任何一個段章內之全部項目，便可於制服佩戴該項目之段章。唯建議以「活動策劃」段章為首個完成之段章。
zh.conditions: 完成「多元技能」段章全部項目（深資童軍獎章）。

en.name: Activity Badge
en.place: Lower wearer's left sleeve, lower row, towards the front (Handbook p.170 figure, “Venture Scout badges and bars”); its Bar goes beneath it. The badges have no fixed order — the first earned goes first (top to bottom, front to back); the model follows the Training Scheme order (Project recommended first).
en.quote: Upon completing any one of the Badges (“Project”, “Service”, “Activity”, and “Exploration”), a Venture Scout may wear the corresponding badge on their uniform. It is highly recommended to complete the “Project” Badge first.
en.conditions: Complete all items of the Activity Badge (Venture Scout Award).

zh.name: 多元技能金帶
zh.place: 穿著者左袖下方下行近前面，多元技能段章下面（手冊 P.170 附圖）。
zh.quote: 深資童軍在完成「榮譽童軍獎章」內「活動策劃」、「社會服務」、「多元技能」及「戶外探險」任何一個項目後，便可在該項目之段章下佩戴一條金帶。
zh.conditions: 完成榮譽童軍獎章「多元技能」項目；要先有多元技能段章。

en.name: Activity Bar
en.place: Lower wearer's left sleeve, lower row, towards the front, beneath the Activity Badge (Handbook p.170 figure).
en.quote: Upon completing all requirements in any section of the Dragon Scout Award (“Project Bar”, “Service Bar”, “Activity Bar”, and “Exploration Bar”), the Venture Scout can wear the Bar under the corresponding Badges on the uniform.
en.conditions: Complete the Activity section of the Dragon Scout Award; needs the Activity Badge.

zh.name: 戶外探險段章
zh.place: 穿著者左袖下方下行近後面（手冊 P.170 附圖「深資童軍段章及金帶」）；金帶喺佢下面。段章冇固定次序，邊個考先就戴先（由上至下、由前至後）；模型示範用綱要建議次序（「活動策劃」首個完成）。
zh.quote: 深資童軍在完成「活動策劃」、「社會服務」、「多元技能」及「戶外探險」任何一個段章內之全部項目，便可於制服佩戴該項目之段章。唯建議以「活動策劃」段章為首個完成之段章。
zh.conditions: 完成「戶外探險」段章全部項目（深資童軍獎章）。

en.name: Exploration Badge

zh.name: 紀念章
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方 3 cm；同宗教章／公教章並排時喺右（外側）。
zh.quote: 紀念章佩戴在制服恤衫右胸袋袋蓋上方三釐米中央位置。假若與其他標誌或徽章一起佩戴，兩章並行排列，紀念章在其右方位置。紀念章最大尺寸以七釐米（闊）× 七釐米（高）為限。
zh.conditions: 只限已獲批准、喺指定期間內佩戴；同一時間只戴一個。

en.name: Commemorative Badge
en.place: 3 cm above the wearer's right pocket flap; right (outer side) when worn with the Religious/Catholic Badge.
en.quote: Worn centred 3 cm above the right pocket flap. With another emblem or badge the two sit side by side, the Commemorative Badge on the right. At most 7 cm wide × 7 cm high.
en.conditions: Approved badges only, within the set period; one at a time.

modelNote.zh: 圖案係手冊示例色塊，每個紀念章唔同；模型用 5 × 5 cm（上限 7 × 7 cm）。
modelNote.en: The artwork is the handbook's example block; each badge differs. The model uses 5 × 5 cm (limit 7 × 7 cm).

zh.name: 金紫荊獎章標誌
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方（緊貼袋蓋）；按次序由右至左（金紫荊、總領袖），深資童軍先修章喺佢哋左方（內側）。
zh.quote: 曾考獲金紫荊獎章、總領袖獎章或榮譽童軍獎章的青少年成員晉升至另一支部，可在制服上佩戴相關獎章標誌，直至完成支部訓練為止。佩戴一個、兩個或三個支部最高獎章標誌，按次序由右至左佩戴在制服恤衫右胸袋袋蓋上方中央位置。
zh.conditions: 以前支部考獲嘅最高獎章；只為青少年成員而設。

en.name: Golden Bauhinia Award Emblem
en.place: On top of the wearer's right pocket flap; right to left in order (Golden Bauhinia, Chief Scout's), with the Venture Scout Link Badge to their left (inner side).
en.quote: Youth members who earned the Golden Bauhinia, Chief Scout's or Hong Kong Scout Award and moved up to another section may wear the emblem until they finish that section's training. The emblems are worn right to left, centred above the right pocket flap.
en.conditions: Highest award of an earlier section; youth members only.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 2.6 × 2 cm 框（按 P.134 圖案比例）。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses a 2.6 × 2 cm box (p.134 artwork proportions).

zh.name: 總領袖獎章標誌
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方（緊貼袋蓋）；按次序由右至左（金紫荊、總領袖），深資童軍先修章喺佢哋左方（內側）。
zh.quote: 曾考獲金紫荊獎章、總領袖獎章或榮譽童軍獎章的青少年成員晉升至另一支部，可在制服上佩戴相關獎章標誌，直至完成支部訓練為止。佩戴一個、兩個或三個支部最高獎章標誌，按次序由右至左佩戴在制服恤衫右胸袋袋蓋上方中央位置。
zh.conditions: 以前支部考獲嘅最高獎章；只為青少年成員而設。

en.name: Chief Scout's Award Emblem
en.place: On top of the wearer's right pocket flap; right to left in order (Golden Bauhinia, Chief Scout's), with the Venture Scout Link Badge to their left (inner side).
en.quote: Youth members who earned the Golden Bauhinia, Chief Scout's or Hong Kong Scout Award and moved up to another section may wear the emblem until they finish that section's training. The emblems are worn right to left, centred above the right pocket flap.
en.conditions: Highest award of an earlier section; youth members only.

zh.name: 深資童軍先修章
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方（緊貼袋蓋）中央；同金紫荊／總領袖獎章標誌一齊戴時喺佢哋左方（內側）。
zh.quote: 符合相關資格的童軍可佩戴在制服恤衫右胸袋袋蓋上方中央位置。晉升深資童軍後，假若與金紫荊／總領袖獎章標誌一起佩戴，先修章在其左方位置（內側）。可佩戴至覆蓋成為深資童軍後一年。
zh.conditions: 童軍支部考獲；晉升深資童軍後可以戴多一年。

en.name: Venture Scout Link Badge
en.place: Centred on top of the wearer's right pocket flap; to the left (inner side) of the Golden Bauhinia / Chief Scout's Award Emblems when worn with them.
en.quote: Qualified Scouts wear it centred above the right pocket flap. After moving up to Venture Scouts, with the Golden Bauhinia / Chief Scout's Award Emblem it goes to their left (inner side). It may be worn until one year after becoming a Venture Scout.
en.conditions: Earned in the Scout Section; worn for one more year after moving up.

modelNote.zh: 圖案取自手冊 P.143；手冊冇寫尺寸，模型用 2.6 × 1.7 cm。
modelNote.en: Artwork from Handbook p.143; no size given, the model uses 2.6 × 1.7 cm.

zh.name: 樂行童軍先修章
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方（緊貼袋蓋）中央；同金紫荊／總領袖獎章標誌、深資童軍先修章一齊戴時喺佢哋左方（最內側）。
zh.quote: 樂行童軍先修章之設立旨在幫助適齡之深資童軍支部成員認識樂行童軍支部活動，鼓勵他們晉升為樂行童軍。年滿十九歲之深資童軍支部成員可考取樂行童軍先修章，完成後由其深資童軍團長簽發。
zh.conditions: 年滿十九歲；完成認許嘅樂行童軍啟導班（或同等項目）同參與最少 2 次同一個樂行童軍團嘅活動（綱要 P.57）。

en.name: Rover Scout Link Badge
en.place: Centred on top of the wearer's right pocket flap; to the left (innermost) of the Golden Bauhinia / Chief Scout's Award Emblems and the Venture Scout Link Badge when worn with them.
en.quote: The Rover Scout Link Badge helps Venture Scouts of the right age learn about Rover Scout activities and encourages them to move up. Venture Scouts aged 19 or over may earn it; it is signed off by their Venture Scout Leader.
en.conditions: Aged 19 or over; complete a recognised Rover Scout Induction Course (or equivalent) and attend at least 2 activities of the same Rover Scout Crew (Training Scheme p.57).

modelNote.zh: 圖案取自綱要 P.57。綱要同手冊都冇寫佢戴喺邊；模型跟童軍先修章（手冊 P.142）同深資童軍先修章（P.143）：右胸袋袋蓋上方、支部最高獎章標誌左方（內側）。尺寸用 2.6 × 1.7 cm（同深資童軍先修章）。
modelNote.en: Artwork from the Training Scheme p.57. Neither the Training Scheme nor the Handbook says where it goes; the model follows the Scout Link Badge (Handbook p.142) and the Venture Scout Link Badge (p.143): above the right pocket flap, to the left (inner side) of the Highest Award Emblems. Size 2.6 × 1.7 cm (as the Venture Scout Link Badge).

zh.name: 飛行章／跳傘章
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋袋蓋上方 2 cm，香港章喺佢上面（手冊 P.150、P.170 附圖）。
zh.quote: 飛行章與跳傘章不可同時佩戴在制服上，只可選擇佩戴其中一項。
zh.conditions: 完成飛行章或跳傘章課程（綱要 P.61）；只可以戴其中一個。

en.name: Flying Badge / Parachute Badge
en.place: 2 cm above the wearer's left pocket flap, with the Hong Kong Badge above it (Handbook p.150 and the p.170 figure).
en.quote: The Flying Badge and Parachute Badge may not be worn together on the uniform; choose one.
en.conditions: Complete the Scout Wings or Scout Canopy Wings course (Training Scheme p.61); only one of the two.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 5.5 cm 闊。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 5.5 cm wide.

zh.name: 服務年星
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋袋蓋上方（緊貼袋蓋）中央；有以前支部嘅服務年星就並排，本支部嗰枚喺最內側（近中線）（手冊 P.130 附圖）。
zh.quote: 各青少年成員在宣誓後服務滿一年者，可在制服上佩戴繡有「1」字的服務年星，兩年則可佩戴繡有「2」字的服務年星，餘此類推。深資童軍：紅色，數目字分別有「1」至「6」。只可佩戴在該支部獲取最高年份的一枚服務年星。
zh.conditions: 宣誓後每服務滿一年；只戴最高年份嗰枚。

en.name: Service Star
en.place: Centred on top of the wearer's left pocket flap; with earlier-section stars they sit side by side, this section's star innermost (nearest the centre) (Handbook p.130 figure).
en.quote: A youth member who has served a full year after investiture wears the star with “1”, two years “2”, and so on. Venture Scouts: red, numbers 1 to 6. Only the highest star of the section is worn.
en.conditions: One per full year of service after investiture; highest only.

modelNote.zh: 紅底白星跟手冊 P.129 深資童軍樣式（顏色取樣自 P.129），數字按揀咗嘅年份；手冊冇寫尺寸，模型用 1.5 cm。以前支部嘅服務年星（P.130：晉支部後仍可佩戴，P.170 附圖並排）未有示範。
modelNote.en: Red with a white star as in the Handbook p.129 Venture Scout sample (colour sampled from p.129), numbered for the chosen year; no size given, the model uses 1.5 cm. Stars from earlier sections (still wearable after moving up, p.130; side by side in the p.170 figure) are not shown.

zh.name: 童軍服務年星（以前支部）
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋袋蓋上方，同深資童軍服務年星並排；由內側（近中線）至外側按支部由高至低（手冊 P.130 附圖）。
zh.quote: 任何童軍在晉團後（例如由小童軍晉團為幼童軍，或由童軍晉團為深資童軍），仍可佩戴以前的服務年星，直至轉任為成年成員。各支部服務年星按次序由左至右並排佩戴在制服恤衫左胸袋袋蓋上方中央位置。童軍：綠色，數目字分別有「1」至「5」。
zh.conditions: 喺童軍支部宣誓後服務滿一年先有；每個支部只戴最高年份嗰枚。

en.name: Scout Service Star (earlier section)
en.place: Above the wearer's left pocket flap, beside the Venture Scout Service Star; sections run from the inner side (nearest the centre) outwards, newest first (Handbook p.130 figure).
en.quote: After moving up (e.g. Grasshopper to Cub Scout, or Scout to Venture Scout) a member may still wear earlier service stars until becoming an adult member. Each section's star is worn side by side, in order from left to right, centred on top of the left pocket flap. Scout: green, numbers 1 to 5.
en.conditions: One per full year of service in that section; highest of each section only.

modelNote.zh: 紅底白星跟手冊 P.129 深資童軍樣式（顏色取樣自 P.129），數字按揀咗嘅年份；手冊冇寫尺寸，模型用 1.5 cm。以前支部嘅服務年星（P.130：晉支部後仍可佩戴，P.170 附圖並排）未有示範。
modelNote.en: Red with a white star as in the Handbook p.129 Venture Scout sample (colour sampled from p.129), numbered for the chosen year; no size given, the model uses 1.5 cm. Stars from earlier sections (still wearable after moving up, p.130; side by side in the p.170 figure) are not shown.

zh.name: 幼童軍服務年星（以前支部）
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋袋蓋上方，同深資童軍服務年星並排；由內側（近中線）至外側按支部由高至低（手冊 P.130 附圖）。
zh.quote: 任何童軍在晉團後（例如由小童軍晉團為幼童軍，或由童軍晉團為深資童軍），仍可佩戴以前的服務年星，直至轉任為成年成員。各支部服務年星按次序由左至右並排佩戴在制服恤衫左胸袋袋蓋上方中央位置。幼童軍：黃色，數目字分別有「1」至「4」。
zh.conditions: 喺幼童軍支部宣誓後服務滿一年先有；每個支部只戴最高年份嗰枚。

en.name: Cub Scout Service Star (earlier section)
en.place: Above the wearer's left pocket flap, beside the Venture Scout Service Star; sections run from the inner side (nearest the centre) outwards, newest first (Handbook p.130 figure).
en.quote: After moving up (e.g. Grasshopper to Cub Scout, or Scout to Venture Scout) a member may still wear earlier service stars until becoming an adult member. Each section's star is worn side by side, in order from left to right, centred on top of the left pocket flap. Cub Scout: yellow, numbers 1 to 4.
en.conditions: One per full year of service in that section; highest of each section only.

modelNote.zh: 紅底白星跟手冊 P.129 深資童軍樣式（顏色取樣自 P.129），數字按揀咗嘅年份；手冊冇寫尺寸，模型用 1.5 cm。以前支部嘅服務年星（P.130：晉支部後仍可佩戴，P.170 附圖並排）未有示範。
modelNote.en: Red with a white star as in the Handbook p.129 Venture Scout sample (colour sampled from p.129), numbered for the chosen year; no size given, the model uses 1.5 cm. Stars from earlier sections (still wearable after moving up, p.130; side by side in the p.170 figure) are not shown.

zh.name: 小童軍服務年星（以前支部）
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋袋蓋上方，同深資童軍服務年星並排；由內側（近中線）至外側按支部由高至低（手冊 P.130 附圖）。
zh.quote: 任何童軍在晉團後（例如由小童軍晉團為幼童軍，或由童軍晉團為深資童軍），仍可佩戴以前的服務年星，直至轉任為成年成員。各支部服務年星按次序由左至右並排佩戴在制服恤衫左胸袋袋蓋上方中央位置。小童軍：橙色，數目字分別有「1」至「3」。
zh.conditions: 喺小童軍支部宣誓後服務滿一年先有；每個支部只戴最高年份嗰枚。小童軍服務年星要晉升幼童軍後先可以戴。

en.name: Grasshopper Service Star (earlier section)
en.place: Above the wearer's left pocket flap, beside the Venture Scout Service Star; sections run from the inner side (nearest the centre) outwards, newest first (Handbook p.130 figure).
en.quote: After moving up (e.g. Grasshopper to Cub Scout, or Scout to Venture Scout) a member may still wear earlier service stars until becoming an adult member. Each section's star is worn side by side, in order from left to right, centred on top of the left pocket flap. Grasshopper: orange, numbers 1 to 3.
en.conditions: One per full year of service in that section; highest of each section only. Grasshopper stars may only be worn after moving up to Cub Scouts.

modelNote.zh: 紅底白星跟手冊 P.129 深資童軍樣式（顏色取樣自 P.129），數字按揀咗嘅年份；手冊冇寫尺寸，模型用 1.5 cm。以前支部嘅服務年星（P.130：晉支部後仍可佩戴，P.170 附圖並排）未有示範。
modelNote.en: Red with a white star as in the Handbook p.129 Venture Scout sample (colour sampled from p.129), numbered for the chosen year; no size given, the model uses 1.5 cm. Stars from earlier sections (still wearable after moving up, p.130; side by side in the p.170 figure) are not shown.

zh.name: 航空活動徽章（空勤員章）
zh.place: 穿著者左袖上方，香港青年獎勵計劃獎章前面一側、低半個章（深資童軍議會「左袖」附圖）。
zh.quote: 「空勤員章課程」分為初級空勤員章、中級空勤員章及高級空勤員章三個階段課程，為深資童軍成員提供全面而富趣味的航空培訓。
zh.conditions: 完成相應階段課程；只戴最高嗰級。深資童軍同樂行童軍用同一個章（用戶確認）。

en.name: Air Activity Badge (Aircrew Badge)
en.place: Upper wearer's left sleeve, beside the HKAYP Award towards the front, half a badge lower (Venture Scout Council “left sleeve” graphic).
en.quote: The Aircrew Syllabus has three stages — Elementary, Intermediate and Advanced Aircrew Badge — giving Venture Scouts comprehensive and enjoyable aviation training.
en.conditions: Complete the matching stage; wear the highest only. Venture and Rover Scouts wear the same badge (user confirmed).

modelNote.zh: 綱要 P.61 冇印徽章圖案（只有網址）；模型三級都用高級空勤員章圖案（樂行童軍綱要 P.35）示意，初級、中級標明係示例。位置跟深資童軍議會附圖：香港青年獎勵計劃獎章前面一側。
modelNote.en: The Training Scheme p.61 prints no artwork (only a link); the model uses the Advanced Air Crew artwork (Rover Training Scheme p.35) for all three levels, marked as an example for Elementary and Intermediate. Position per the Venture Scout Council graphic: beside the HKAYP Award, towards the front.

zh.name: 海上活動徽章
zh.place: 穿著者左袖上方，香港青年獎勵計劃獎章後面一側、低半個章（深資童軍議會「左袖」附圖）。
zh.quote: 「童軍標準艇課程（深資童軍支部課程）」分為水手長章（三級童軍標準艇證書）、副舵手章（四級童軍標準艇證書）及舵手章（五級童軍標準艇證書）三個階段課程。如由童軍支部成員晉升為深資童軍支部成員，並已考獲三級童軍標準艇證書，在晉升為深資童軍支部成員後，可直接佩戴深資童軍水手長章。
zh.conditions: 完成相應階段課程；只戴最高嗰級。深資童軍同樂行童軍用同一個章（用戶確認）。

en.name: Sea Activity Badge
en.place: Upper wearer's left sleeve, beside the HKAYP Award towards the back, half a badge lower (Venture Scout Council “left sleeve” graphic).
en.quote: The Scout Standard Boat Syllabus (Venture Scout Section) has three stages: Boatswain (Level 3 certificate), Coxswain's Mate (Level 4) and Coxswain (Level 5). A Scout who already holds the Level 3 certificate may wear the Venture Scout Boatswain Badge directly after moving up.
en.conditions: Complete the matching stage; wear the highest only. Venture and Rover Scouts wear the same badge (user confirmed).

modelNote.zh: 綱要 P.62 冇印徽章圖案（只有網址）；模型三級都用舵手章圖案（樂行童軍綱要 P.35）示意，水手長、副舵手標明係示例。
modelNote.en: The Training Scheme p.62 prints no artwork (only a link); the model uses the Helmsman artwork (Rover Training Scheme p.35) for all three levels, marked as an example for Boatswain and Coxswain's Mate.

zh.name: 香港青年獎勵計劃獎章
zh.place: 穿著者左袖上方中央最高位置（深資童軍議會「左袖」附圖）。
zh.quote: 佩戴在制服恤衫左袖上方中央位置。假若與深資童軍急救章一起佩戴，獎章在其下方位置。童軍、深資童軍及樂行童軍假若曾考獲不同等級的獎章，只可佩戴最高等級的一個。
zh.conditions: 只戴最高嗰個（銅、銀、金）。

en.name: Hong Kong Award for Young People
en.place: Top centre of the upper wearer's left sleeve (Venture Scout Council “left sleeve” graphic).
en.quote: Worn at the upper centre of the left sleeve; with the Venture Scout First Aid Badge it goes below it. Members holding awards of different levels wear only the highest.
en.conditions: Highest only (Bronze, Silver, Gold).

zh.name: 童軍拯溺布章
zh.place: 穿著者左袖中央，深資童軍急救章下面（深資童軍議會「左袖」附圖）。
zh.quote: 凡考獲中國香港拯溺總會拯溺資格的童軍成員，可佩戴童軍拯溺布章於制服上。
zh.conditions: 持有效拯溺資格；證書有效期內。

en.name: Scout Life Saving Cloth Badge
en.place: Centre of the wearer's left sleeve, below the Venture Scout First Aid Badge (Venture Scout Council “left sleeve” graphic).
en.quote: Members holding a Hong Kong China Life Saving Society qualification may wear the Scout Life Saving Cloth Badge.
en.conditions: Valid life saving qualification; while valid.

zh.name: 模範童軍肩帶（雞繩）
zh.place: 掛喺右肩肩帶下面，兜過膊頭沿袖窿前面落去，末端扣喺右胸袋袋蓋左方（近中線）。
zh.quote: 當選模範童軍的青少年成員可佩戴模範童軍肩帶。肩帶掛在制服恤衫右肩肩帶之下，肩帶末端扣在右胸袋袋蓋左方位置。成年成員可繼續佩戴；假若同時獲頒香港總監嘉許或高級嘉許，只可選擇佩戴其中一條。不可佩戴在西服、制服毛衣、禮服及晚禮服上。
zh.conditions: 當選模範童軍（模範童軍選舉）；之後成為成年成員仍可佩戴。

en.name: Model Scout Lanyard
en.place: Under the wearer's right shoulder strap, over the shoulder and down the front of the armhole, its end clipped at the left (inner) side of the right pocket flap.
en.quote: Youth members elected Model Scout may wear the Model Scout lanyard. It hangs under the right shoulder strap of the uniform shirt, its end clipped at the left of the right pocket flap. Adult members may continue to wear it; if they also hold the Chief Commissioner's Commendation or High Commendation, they choose one of the two to wear. Not worn on the suit, uniform jersey, dress uniform or mess dress.
en.conditions: Elected Model Scout (Scout of the Year election); may still be worn as an adult member.

modelNote.zh: 肩帶用 3D 繩示意：深綠同金黃兩色扭紋，末端有穗（P.158 相片，俗稱「雞繩」）；選單細圖係 P.158 相片。路線同嘉許笛繩一樣但喺右肩（左右反轉）：由右肩肩帶下面（膊頭嗰頭）穿出，兜過袖頂前邊、沿袖窿前面落到胸袋下面，再兜返上右胸袋袋蓋近中線嗰邊；後面一段沿袖窿後面落到腋下同前面接埋，成個圈套住右膊。童軍模型冇畫肩帶，繩直接喺膊頭上面經過。
modelNote.en: The lanyard is a 3D cord: dark green and gold twisted, with a tassel at the end (p.158 photo); the menu thumbnail is the p.158 photo. It follows the same route as the commendation lanyard but on the right shoulder (mirrored): out from under the right shoulder strap at the shoulder end, over the front of the sleeve top, down the front of the armhole to below the pocket, then up to the inner side of the right pocket flap; a back strand runs down the back of the armhole to the armpit, so the cord loops round the right shoulder. The Scout model has no shoulder straps drawn, so the cord simply passes over the shoulder.

notAllowed.zh: 深資童軍制服頁冇小隊章（手冊 P.36–41；綱要 P.14–15）。
notAllowed.en: There is no Patrol Badge on the Venture Scout uniform page (Handbook pp.36–41; Training Scheme pp.14–15).

notAllowed.zh: 舊「深資童軍世界童軍環境章」（2026 年綱要已冇）未有示範。
notAllowed.en: The old Venture Scout World Scout Environment Badge (dropped from the 2026 Training Scheme) is not shown.

uninvested.zh: 未宣誓嘅青少年成員（小童軍除外）可穿著全套制服（不需扣上衣領鈕扣）；世界童軍會員章、制服帽同旅巾需待宣誓後纔可佩戴。深資童軍肩章要完成肩章訓練先可以戴。
uninvested.en: Uninvested youth members (except Grasshoppers) may wear the full uniform (top button undone); the World Membership Badge, uniform cap and neckerchief are worn only after investiture. The Venture Scout Epaulettes are worn only after completing the epaulette training.

conflicts.zh: 地域章／區章：手冊 P.95 文字「地域章在前，區章在後」，P.170 附圖一致；附圖喺旅章下面先有深資童軍急救章（考獲先有，P.148），模型開咗急救章就照附圖將地域章、區章向下移，冇就照 P.95 喺旅章下 2 cm。
conflicts.en: Region/District: Handbook p.95 says Region in front, District behind, and the p.170 figure agrees; the figure has the (earned) Venture Scout First Aid Badge under the Group Badge (p.148). With it on, the model moves the Region and District Badges down as in the figure; without it they sit 2 cm below the Group Badge (p.95).

conflicts.zh: 非基本章：2026 年 8 月版綱要（第 11 版）冇佩戴位置圖，所以位置跟手冊 P.170 附圖同 P.129–157 文字；章嘅名稱、圖案同考取次序跟綱要（用戶指示：同樂行童軍一樣以綱要為準）——新段章「活動策劃／社會服務／多元技能／戶外探險」同金帶、深資童軍獎章、榮譽童軍獎章（英文 Dragon Scout Award）、深資童軍急救章新圖案；手冊附圖嘅「深資童軍世界童軍環境章」改為綱要第三章嘅世界童軍組織徽章（地球部落等），同社區參與章一行最多四個（參照樂行童軍綱要 P.12）。兩份文件有矛盾就以綱要為準（較新），綱要冇寫嘅跟手冊（用戶指示）。
conflicts.en: Non-basic badges: the August 2026 Training Scheme (11th edition) has no wearing chart, so positions follow the Handbook p.170 figure and pp.129–157 text, while badge names, artwork and the award sequence follow the Training Scheme (user instruction: like the Rover Scouts, the Training Scheme takes precedence) — the new Project / Service / Activity / Exploration Badges and Bars, the Venture Scout Award, the Dragon Scout Award and the new First Aid artwork; the figure's Venture Scout World Scout Environment Badge is replaced by the chapter 3 WOSM badges (Earth Tribe etc.), in one row with the Community Involvement Badge, at most four (as in the Rover Training Scheme p.12). Where the two conflict the Training Scheme (newer) wins; anything it does not cover follows the Handbook (user instruction).

conflicts.zh: 深資童軍議會最新制服附圖（用戶提供）同手冊 P.148–157／P.170 附圖同綱要 P.50 唔同：和平使者章改戴左胸袋中央代替世界童軍會員章；急救章改用樂行童軍新圖案、只戴左袖（香港青年獎勵計劃獎章同航空／海上活動徽章下面）；拯溺布章喺急救章下面；社區參與章改戴左袖、縮細為 4 cm；右袖地域章／區章下面一行世界童軍組織徽章 4 cm、最多四個。模型跟最新附圖（用戶指示）。
conflicts.en: The latest Venture Scout Council uniform graphics (supplied by the user) differ from Handbook pp.148–157, the p.170 figure and the Training Scheme p.50: the Messengers of Peace Badge goes at the centre of the left pocket in place of the World Membership Badge; the First Aid Badge uses the Rover Scouts' new design on the left sleeve only (below the HKAYP Award and the Air/Sea Activity Badges); the Life Saving Badge sits below it; the Community Involvement Badge moves to the left sleeve at 4 cm; on the right sleeve one row of WOSM badges at 4 cm, at most four, below the Region/District Badges. The model follows the latest graphics (user instruction).

artCredit.zh: 徽章圖案取自香港童軍總會《儀容與制服手冊》P.25、P.92–93、P.102、P.145、P.159 及香港童軍總會網頁「地域及區」，版權屬香港童軍總會。旅章係手冊示例圖案；區章、地域章可以揀返自己嘅。
artCredit.en: Badge artwork is from the Scout Association of Hong Kong Uniform Handbook (pp.25, 92–93, 102, 145, 159) and the SAHK “Regions and Districts” page; copyright the Scout Association of Hong Kong. The Group Badge is the handbook example; pick your own District to get the right badges.

pocketR.zh: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方：下層（緊貼袋蓋）支部最高獎章標誌（金紫荊、總領袖，由右至左）同先修章（深資童軍先修章、樂行童軍先修章，喺佢哋左方、內側）；上層（袋蓋上方 3 cm）宗教章／公教章、紀念章，宗教章／公教章喺左（內側）。和平使者章改戴左胸袋中央（深資童軍議會附圖）。
pocketR.en: Above the wearer's right pocket flap: lower row (on the flap) the Highest Award Emblems (Golden Bauhinia, Chief Scout's; right to left) and the Link Badges (Venture Scout, Rover Scout) to their left (inner side); upper row (3 cm above the flap) the Religious/Catholic Badge and the Commemorative Badge, the Religious/Catholic Badge on the left (inner side). The Messengers of Peace Badge now goes at the centre of the left pocket (Venture Scout Council graphic).

pocketL.zh: 穿著者左胸袋袋蓋上方：服務年星緊貼袋蓋，以前支部嘅年星並排喺外側（手冊 P.130）；飛行章／跳傘章喺袋蓋上方 2 cm，香港章喺佢上面（手冊 P.93、P.150、P.170 附圖；只得香港章就喺袋蓋上方 3 cm）。
pocketL.en: Above the wearer's left pocket flap: the Service Star on the flap, earlier-section stars beside it towards the outside (Handbook p.130); the Flying/Parachute Badge 2 cm above the flap with the Hong Kong Badge above it (Handbook pp.93, 150 and the p.170 figure; the Hong Kong Badge alone sits 3 cm above the flap).

sleeveR.zh: 穿著者右袖、旅章下面 2 cm：地域章（前）、區章（後），相距 1 cm；再下面一行世界童軍組織徽章（4 cm）同「積極公民」獎章，最多合共四個（深資童軍議會「右袖」附圖；手冊 P.95）。急救章同社區參與章已改戴左袖。四個格位固定（由前面排起），只係放咩同放幾多個唔同，唔會因為得一個就置中（用戶指示）。
sleeveR.en: Wearer's right sleeve, 2 cm below the Group Badge: the Region (front) and District (back) Badges 1 cm apart; below them one row of WOSM badges (4 cm) and Active Citizen badges, at most four in total (Venture Scout Council “right sleeve” graphic; Handbook p.95). The First Aid and Community Involvement Badges have moved to the left sleeve. The four positions are fixed (filled from the front); only what goes in them and how many change — a single badge is not centred (user instruction).

sleeveL.zh: 穿著者左袖上方中央一行落：香港青年獎勵計劃獎章（最高）；航空活動徽章（前）、海上活動徽章（後）喺佢兩側、低半個章；跟住深資童軍急救章（新圖案，同樂行童軍一樣）、拯溺布章、社區參與章（4 cm）。段章同金帶喺兩側（深資童軍議會「左袖」附圖）。冇嘅就由上面補上。
sleeveL.en: Down the centre of the upper wearer's left sleeve: the HKAYP Award at the top; the Air Activity (front) and Sea Activity (back) Badges either side of it, half a badge lower; then the Venture Scout First Aid Badge (new design, same as the Rover Scouts'), the Life Saving Badge and the Community Involvement Badge (4 cm). The stage badges and bars sit either side (Venture Scout Council “left sleeve” graphic). Rows move up when one is empty.
